name: catter
author: clice-io
description: Catter QuickJS runtime API types and editor hints.

scripts.clean:lib: pnpm run rm ../build/lib && pnpm run rm ../dist
scripts.clean: pnpm run rm ../build && pnpm run rm ../dist && pnpm run rm ../types
scripts.compile:runtime: pnpm run check:modules && tsc --project tsconfig.app.json --declaration false --declarationDir null --declarationMap false
scripts.build: run-s clean compile && run-p package:runtime compile:test
